parole.testo: Vasmer derives this word from Proto-Indo-European *kelh₁- (“to call”), cf. Latvian kalada (“noise, quarrel”). He rejects connections to Hungarian koldulni (“to beg”) and Ancient Greek Χαλδαῖος (Khaldaîos, “Chaldean”), otherwise surfacing in Russian as халде́й (xaldéj, “Chaldean; soothsayer”), althou
